name: How long does it typically take to complete a home addition project?
description: Home addition timelines range from 3-6 months for small projects to over a year for larger ones, depending on complexity and permitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home addition project depends on its size, complexity, and the necessary permitting process. A smaller addition, like a single room, might take 3-6 months from design to completion. Larger or multi-story additions could extend to 8-12 months or more. Permitting can add several weeks to months, so starting this process early is crucial. We work to establish a realistic timeline upfront and keep you informed throughout each phase.
